name: João Augusto de Nardo
bio: Born and raised in Brazil, João Augusto De Nardo has independently written, directed, and produced short films, anthology films, and feature horror films, leading to official selections at more than 50 international genre film festivals around the world.

credits.title: Shotgun Hooker
credits.overview: When Ash inherits her late father’s remote Southern home, she and her girlfriend see it as a fresh start. But their new neighbors have other plans. What begins as unsettling hostility soon spirals into torture, murder, and unimaginable loss.

credits.title: Red Lips
credits.overview: Told entirely through a laptop screen, Red Lips follows Lisa as her academic research into online vampire communities collapses into something far more personal when she finds Caroline.

credits.title: Don’t Watch Til Christmas
credits.overview: Between blood in the snow and gifts no one asked for, Don't Watch Til Christmas turns the most wonderful night of the year into the most cursed.

credits.title: Dead Girls Don’t Scream
credits.overview: The mind of a necrophiliac cannibal is haunted by guilt and remorse

credits.title: Pigstown
credits.overview: The pigs are everywhere. A descent into a man’s private hell.

credits.title: VHS Horror Workout
credits.overview: Amanda, a hardworking dancer, becomes entangled in a series of brutal murders. As she digs deeper into the mystery, reality and nightmare begin to blur, forcing her to confront a killer whose identity lies hidden in the shadows of her own mind.

credits.title: Cast
credits.overview: A struggling videographer answers an ad to document a sculptor's creative process. What starts as a quiet job becomes an isolated nightmarish stay at a farmhouse.

credits.title: Death Always Craves
credits.overview: The story follows a young pregnant woman who, upon visiting her ailing mother, finds herself trapped in a whirlwind of supernatural events and dark secrets that connect her to the mysterious past of the old residence.

credits.title: Agatha Didn't Kill Her Psychiatrist
credits.overview: In a therapy session, secrets emerge, turning the encounter between Ágatha and her psychiatrist into a dangerous psychological game.

credits.title: Stabbington
credits.overview: Don’t take him home

credits.title: Where Darkness Breathes
credits.overview: A Latin American horror anthology where filmmakers from conjure shadows rooted in their land, their ghosts, and their history.

credits.title: I Will Kill You
credits.overview: An English lesson turns deadly.

credits.title: Viral
credits.overview: During a live broadcast, a digital performer finds herself strangely alone in front of only one viewer.

credits.title: U.V.F: Underground Video Films
credits.overview: Presented as a forbidden TV broadcast, this horror anthology revives unsettling short films from the world.

credits.title: VHS Underground
credits.overview: When pathologists K. Daver (Laurence R. Harvey) and Owen Graves (Jean Rises) discover a USB drive inside a corpse, curiosity leads them into horror. The files reveal disturbing recordings of murder and torture, drawing them into madness.

credits.title: Corrupted Pleasure
credits.overview: A corrupted file seduces the viewer

credits.title: We Become One
credits.overview: In a dark room, two clay beings share their first kiss.

credits.title: Mall Santas Must Die
credits.overview: Unearthed from the ruins of a burned-down Canadian video store, this long-lost slasher is finally back to stuff your stocking - with screams.

credits.title: SlashFM II
credits.overview: Count Slashula brings more terrifying tales on a Halloween Night.

credits.title: Late Checkout
credits.overview: The small town of "Banner Elk" has fallen victim to a serial killer dubbed, "The Banner Elk Butcher," who makes art out of his victims in a brutal fashion. A group of friends are about to discover just how brutal his art can be.

credits.title: All That You Love Will Be Destroyed
credits.overview: As Zimmer (Kaio Ramos) goes on a mental journey, he discovers that sometimes the deepest answers can be hidden in encrypted messages. Based on the short story "All That You Love Will Be Carried Away" by Stephen King.

credits.title: Murdercise
credits.overview: Phoebe is an obsessed fitness nerd who gets her big break on a sleazy workout video. After being ridiculed by her co-stars, Phoebe befriends a mafia princess wild child, who teaches her how to murder her way to the top.

credits.title: Encontro Marcado com a Morte
credits.overview: In "Encontro Marcado com a Morte" we follow the night of a couple of strangers who decide to have dinner with the aim of getting to know each other better. But what revelations and mysteries could this meeting provide?

credits.title: Bathtub Shark Attack
credits.overview: A young down-on-their-luck couple settle for a cheap apartment that seems too good to be true. Little do they know, something lurks in the drain of the bathtub. Something that's thousands of years old...and it is hungry.

credits.title: SlashFM
credits.overview: A radio show by Count Slashula at 'Slash FM', on a Halloween Night, will be presenting and warning viewers about the creepy stories they are about to watch, involving death, blood and some laughs. (inspired by Creepshow and Body Bags)

credits.title: Mothman
credits.overview: Amanda and her boyfriend Tim set out to shed light on the case surrounding her missing brother. After finding his lost archive, she uncovers a truth that leads her down a path to the horror her brother unwillingly encountered.
